recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Revisit only if a future work-group decision supplies specific new multi-server requirements beyond the FHIR-16031 guidance already present.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive with Modification issue requesting that multi-server and multiple data-source considerations be gathered into a single section in managing.html, with implementer considerations and a note that the base specification cannot prescribe every architecture.
initial_application: The issue was implemented by Lloyd McKenzie's GF#16031 commit bbc1cebc834e1f26946404e869dccfa1024115c2 and merged as aac677808db9e09e9bef639d8ab432240b5ae6f9. That source change added the multi-server guidance to source/managing.html.
additional_context: The 2018-07-09 FHIR-I minutes corroborate the Persuasive with Modification disposition. The current Managing Resource Identity page is listed in source/hierarchy.xml, so source/managing.html is in build scope. A later related issue, FHIR-19661, was Resolved - No Change after the work group concluded the managing.html task had been applied and no additional concrete framework was available.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit because the current source already contains the requested guidance on discovery, shared entities, synchronization, cross-server query behavior, and storage-location decisions.

related_jiras.note: Later Resolved - No Change request about adding multi-version concerns to the same multi-server discussion; it supports leaving FHIR-16031 without further edits.
